Bumps the npm-minor-patch group in /frontend with 4 updates: [next](https://github.com/vercel/next.js), [@tailwindcss/postcss](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/tree/HEAD/packages/@tailwindcss-postcss), [eslint-config-next](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/HEAD/packages/eslint-config-next) and [tailwindcss](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/tree/HEAD/packages/tailwindcss).

Updates `next` from 16.4.3 to 16.4.5
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/releases">next's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>v16.4.5</h2>
<p>This release contains security fixes for the following advisories:</p>
<h2>Moderate</h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-mfr8-8qww-v76h">Cross-tenant sensitive information disclosure in Next.js 'use cache' when called through unstable_cache</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-vc7v-qv4w-wrv8">Cache leak across root param values in nested 'use cache' functions (follow-up)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-vvgp-ww4w-46vf">Cache poisoning of shared fallback shells in Cache Components via request-supplied placeholder route params</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-rhh4-g77r-r9qj">Cross-user cache disclosure and poisoning in Next.js use cache with binary arguments</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-pc58-hwjq-p385">Cross-client response injection and disclosure in self-hosted Next.js applications forwarding fetched responses</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-7qx7-33qx-rqx2">SVG rejection bypass in Next.js image optimization</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-f3mh-rxg3-f5g2">HttpOnly cookie exposure through internal response header on Next.js Edge runtime routes</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
